row --card --step --lane --model --before 'five,week,fable' --after 'five,week,fable' [--transcript P --minutes N --source S]: exit 1 and no write if either read is missing; header written only if the file is absent.

Parser: per assistant line read message.usage input_tokens, output_tokens; tokens_cache = cache_read_input_tokens + cache_creation_input_tokens; dedupe by message.id, skip lines without usage. Unreadable or malformed file gives empty token cells and exit 0.

idle --reset <UTC ISO>: 5h% and week% from the newest CSV row of the lane (pct5h_after, pctweek_after); IDLE <lane> when 5h<40% and a task card with that lane is ready, or week% under pace (elapsed share of 7 days from --reset) with no claim in sync.py claims, within 60 min of reset. Thresholds OURS.
summary: row count and mean (tokens_in+out+cache) per card kind (kind = card worker field), over rows that have token cells.
